description: Docked session sidebar: model, usage, session, workspace, CI and tasks

discountPercent.title: Billing discount (%)
discountPercent.description: Your discount off Anthropic's published prices. The sidebar takes it off the session cost and the cache rebuild cost. 0 shows list prices.

showGbp.title: GBP rate (£)
showGbp.description: On: costs also show in £, after the $ figure, at the European Central Bank's daily rate (fetched from frankfurter.dev at most 4 times a day). Anthropic bills in dollars, so £ is a guide. /gbp switches it too.
